source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 1: velocity from s(t) = 5t^3 - 3t^2 + t (book p.257). Answer key (PDF 311) prints it as number 4.

blocks.prompt: 1. A car's position at time \(t\) is given by \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 3t^2 + t\). Find the velocity by differentiating the position function with respect to time.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh motion (harkat) ka sawal hai: position di hui hai aur velocity chahiye.
Humein \(v(t)\) find karni hai.
Yaad karein: velocity ka matlab hai position kitni tezi se badal rahi hai, yani position ka derivative.
Plan: \(s(t)\) ko \(t\) ke lehaz se differentiate karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(s(t) = 5t^3 - 3t^2 + t\).
Humein find karna hai: \(v(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(v(t) = s'(t) = \frac{ds}{dt}\). Section 13.2.1 mein parha tha ke instantaneous velocity position ka derivative hai. Har term par power rule lagayenge; yahan variable \(x\) ke bajaye \(t\) hai, qaida wohi hai.

Term by term differentiate karein
\[v(t) = \frac{d}{dt}(5t^3) - \frac{d}{dt}(3t^2) + \frac{d}{dt}(t)\]
\[= 15t^2 - 6t + 1\]
Kyun: Power rule: \(5t^3 \to 5 \cdot 3t^2 = 15t^2\), \(3t^2 \to 6t\), aur \(t \to 1\). Misaal: agar car ki position har second badal rahi ho to yeh formula batata hai ke kisi bhi lamhe par car kitni tez chal rahi hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{At } t = 1:\ v = 15 - 6 + 1 = 10\]
\[\frac{s(1.001) - s(0.999)}{0.002} \approx 10.00\]
Kyun: \(t = 1\) ke ird gird bohat chhote waqfe mein average velocity nikali, woh bhi 10 aayi. Yahi to derivative ka matlab hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 4 par chhapa hai: \(v = 15t^2 - 6t + 1\), jo sahi hai.
